a.lede: Jensen Huang is being investigated by his own company over an extramarital affair with a woman alleged to be a Chinese spy.
a.title: Zoe Kleinman: Nvidia CEO's affair will cause ripples across US and beyond

b.lede: The US president said he spoke with Jensen Huang on Monday and asked him about the affair with the alleged spy.
b.title: Trump says FBI investigating Nvidia boss's affair with alleged Chinese spy
